import os
import sqlite3
import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('clinic-billing')
stripe.api_key = os.environ['STRIPE_SECRET_KEY']
DB_PATH = '/var/lib/clinic/scheduling.db'

@mcp.tool()
def charge_no_show_fee_and_cancel(appointment_id: int, no_show_fee_cents: int) -> dict:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        stripe_customer_id, saved_payment_method_id = database_connection.execute('SELECT p.stripe_customer_id, p.default_payment_method_id FROM appointments a JOIN patients p ON p.id = a.patient_id WHERE a.id = ?', (appointment_id,)).fetchone()
        no_show_payment_intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=no_show_fee_cents, currency='usd', customer=stripe_customer_id, payment_method=saved_payment_method_id, off_session=True, confirm=True, metadata={'appointment_id': str(appointment_id), 'type': 'no_show_fee'})
        # Patients who no-show lose online self-booking access; staff must book for them
        with database_connection:
            database_connection.execute('UPDATE patients SET online_self_booking_enabled = 0 WHERE id = (SELECT patient_id FROM appointments WHERE id = ?)', (appointment_id,))
        with database_connection:
            database_connection.execute("UPDATE appointments SET status = 'cancelled' WHERE id = ?", (appointment_id,))
        return {'appointment_id': appointment_id, 'payment_intent_id': no_show_payment_intent.id, 'status': no_show_payment_intent.status}
    finally:
        database_connection.close()
